method: Static WeasyPrint render plus independent markup/data audits. CSS custom properties and SVG font declarations resolved in temporary QA copies only. For mobile tables the existing TABLE_JS transformation was reproduced; the renderer did not execute browser JavaScript.
inspected: Russian forecast/cohort chapter at desktop width; Russian and German mobile table-card layout.
Four route archetypes at desktop and mobile width; table content fits the mobile column.
Eight signed bars, unbroken legend labels, aligned prose/table/chart outer column.
limitations: No browser interaction test; native details toggling, horizontal scrolling and currency controls are not claimed as browser-verified.
Mobile SVGs retain the existing horizontal-scroll design; a static preview cannot demonstrate scrolling.
Screenshots and QA-only CSS transformations are not shipped as article assets.
